question: Where should the practitioner ritually place the lord of gods and Vaṭuka?
premises: The lord of gods is to be placed at the feet.
Vaṭuka is to be placed in all the limbs.
The act prescribed is ritual placement.
inference: The practitioner should place the lord of gods at the feet and Vaṭuka in all the limbs.
plain_english: One should place the lord of gods at the feet and Vaṭuka in all the limbs.
